lines: All stations, this is launch control. We are in terminal count.
Weather is go. Upper level winds are within limits.
Weather is marginal, but within limits. We are go.
Range is green. Range is go for launch.
Propellant loading is complete. The vehicle is in launch configuration.
Propellant topping is in progress. Liquid oxygen venting is normal.
Launch director, flight. Mission control is go for launch.
The poll is complete. We are go for launch.
The vehicle has transferred to internal power.
T minus one minute, and counting.
T minus forty five seconds. The vehicle is go for launch.
The auto sequence has started. Flight computers are in control.
Tower is clear. Mission control has the vehicle.
Pitch program initiated. The vehicle is downrange.
Max Q. The vehicle is passing through maximum aerodynamic pressure.
Booster burnout. Stand by for booster separation.
Solid rocket booster separation. Good separation.
Upper stage engine ignition. We have good thrust.
You have crossed one hundred kilometers. Welcome to space.
Orbit insertion confirmed. Welcome to orbit.
We have a good orbit. Go for orbit operations.
Engine cutoff. You are on a suborbital trajectory. Enjoy the view.
Spacecraft separation confirmed. The payload is free flying.
Boostback burn complete. The booster is headed home.
We have lost telemetry from the booster.
You are go for trans lunar injection.
Trans lunar injection complete. You are on your way to the Moon.
You are now in the Moon's sphere of influence.
Loss of signal in one minute as you pass behind the Moon. We'll see you on the other side.
Acquisition of signal. Good to hear from you again.
Lunar orbit insertion complete. You are in orbit around the Moon.
Closest approach to the Moon. What a view.
You are go for powered descent.
Descent rate is high. Throttle up.
Touchdown. We copy you down on the Moon. Beautiful work.
You are go for lunar ascent.
Trans Earth injection complete. You are headed home.
You have left the Moon's sphere of influence.
You have escaped Earth's gravity. You are now in orbit around the Sun.
Welcome back to Earth's sphere of influence.
You have entered Jupiter's sphere of influence.
Closest approach to Jupiter. Gravity assist in progress.
Jupiter flyby complete. That is a historic achievement.
You are go for the deorbit burn.
Deorbit burn complete. You are on your way home.
Entry interface. The spacecraft is entering the atmosphere.
We expect loss of signal during plasma blackout. See you on the other side.
Heat shield temperature is approaching limits.
Heat shield is failing! Check your attitude!
Main parachutes deployed. We have good chutes.
Velocity is too high for parachute deployment.
Engine out. Continuing on the remaining engines.
Angle of attack is too high.
Aerodynamic loads are high. Watch your attitude.
Flight, we have lost the vehicle.
Launch escape system fired. The crew module is clear.
Hold. Hold. Hold. We are holding the count.
Mission failure. Let's secure our data and figure out what happened.
Coast phase. You are clear to time warp.
Approaching apoapsis. Stand by for the circularization burn.
Your periapsis is inside the atmosphere.
Orbital sunrise coming up. Enjoy it.
You are crossing into Earth's shadow.
